items.summary: The White House approved federal emergency declarations for Florida and Alabama ahead of Isaias's landfall (Friday Oct 9); FEMA is authorized to provide direct federal assistance for emergency protective measures with 75% federal cost share. Florida's declaration covers 27 Panhandle/Big Bend counties incl. Escambia, Santa Rosa, Okaloosa, Walton, Bay and Leon; Alabama's covers Baldwin, Escambia and Mobile counties plus the Poarch Band of Creek Indians. Brett H. Howard named Federal Coordinating Officer for Florida, Willie G. Nunn for Alabama; FEMA says additional designations may follow as damage is assessed. This never surfaced in the watch's feed before; Reuters restated the approvals in its Oct-13 wrap.
items.title: Federal emergency declarations approved for Florida and Alabama (Isaias)
